story.heading: The first highlight of the Schipper Exclusive Collection
story.p1: Some designs are created – and you know straight away: this one is special.
story.p2: That is exactly how we felt about Bloom Spirit. We are not showing everything yet, but this much we can reveal: Bloom Spirit is the first design of the Schipper Exclusive Collection – and will only be available 3,000 times.
story.p3: If you want to be the first to catch a glimpse of the new design and get a chance at one of the few copies, register for early access now.
